Settings modal shows deadline-emails-row and toggle works with toast + aria-pressed change.

action_items: Update server.py L2370 and L2381 to replace '7-day free trial' phrasing in the taster upsell (both the HTTP 429 message and the LLM system-prompt CTA sentence) with trial-free wording (e.g. 'Sign up free for unlimited Lex chat, case files, and your private Vault.').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~16,364 lines — very large; consider splitting by domain (reminders, cases, auth, firm) into submodules.

_job_deadline_reminder_emails updates emailed_days only when the Resend send succeeds — correct, but has subtle consequence: a transient Resend failure for a user with example.com/invalid email will cause the next cron run to retry and eventually mark the day. Fine as-is, but worth noting (can look like a stuck reminder in logs).

cron_deadline_reminders dedupes by X-Webhook-Id via a unique _id insert, but uses the catch-all `except Exception` to return duplicate — any other mongo error would also be reported as duplicate=true. Consider narrowing to DuplicateKeyError.
create_reminder trims title to 200 and description to 500 with raw slicing; may truncate mid-grapheme for non-English scripts. Minor.
test_credentials: admin@aiadvocate.co.uk / AdminLex2026! (used read-only); UI test used a fresh @example.com user that was auto-verified in Mongo and then cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created 167 temporary TEST_/UI_ users + 21 cases + 21 reminders + 78 conversations during testing — ALL CLEANED UP post-run (confirmed in Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To bypass email verification on fresh @example.com test users, directly set email_verified=true in Mongo (match on the stored email WITHOUT lowercasing — signup stores case-preserved email). Signup response field is `access_token`, not `token`. For cron emailed_days tests, Resend rejects @example.com — use `delivered+TAG@resend.dev` so Resend accepts and the job persists emailed_days.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested features working. Only follow-up: two backend strings still reference '7-day free trial' (taster upsell paths).
